rule: every entry was read from StatsAPI (/people/search by name, or /people by id) and accepted only when its mlbDebutDate year equals the record's debut year and, where the record's birth date is plausible for that debut, its birthDate equals it; zero ambiguous hits accepted, each listed under manual_review. Consumers: the label join (tools/rebase_career_war.py reads entries FIRST, then player_photos, then the override files; the career_war fetch) and debuts.json's mlbam_id. efv_identity never reads this file.
